studies.title: The backstaff
studies.caption: John Davis's quadrant measures the Sun's height by the shadow it casts, with the navigator's back to the Sun.
studies.prompt: Close three-quarter object study of a wooden Davis backstaff on a weathered shipboard table: unequal graduated arcs on opposite sides of a long strut, triangular braces and small sight, horizon and shadow vanes. One hand steadies the frame; sea and rigging behind. No observer sighting through it, no visible sun, no later glass lens, no readable inscriptions. The instrument structure follows Royal Museums Greenwich NAV0045; this is an interpretive study of the device, not a scene dated to a specific voyage.
